# `csharp_indent_braces`

Indent the brace tokens themselves an extra level.

## Values

| Value | Notes |
|---|---|
| `true` |  |
| `false` |  |

**Default:** `false`

## Conformance

No known case where Curb's output is not a fixed point of `dotnet format` — see [conformance](../../design-principles/conformance.md).

### `csharp_indent_braces = true`

```ini
csharp_indent_braces = true
```

::::{tab-set}

:::{tab-item} Before
```csharp
namespace N;

public class Widget
{
    public void Run()
    {
        Console.WriteLine("hello");
    }
}
```
:::

:::{tab-item} After
```csharp
namespace N;

public class Widget
    {
    public void Run()
        {
        Console.WriteLine("hello");
        }
    }
```
:::

::::

### `csharp_indent_braces = false`

```ini
csharp_indent_braces = false
```

::::{tab-set}

:::{tab-item} Before
```csharp
namespace N;

public class Widget
{
    public void Run()
    {
        Console.WriteLine("hello");
    }
}
```
:::

:::{tab-item} After
```csharp
namespace N;

public class Widget
{
    public void Run()
    {
        Console.WriteLine("hello");
    }
}
```
:::
